content.title: Who is Cameron Young’s caddie?
content.text: He helped his boss finally get over the line on the PGA Tour in 2025, but who is Cameron Young’s caddie?Cameron Young is a winner on the PGA Tour from Scarborough, New York. Young’s debut victory on the PGA Tour was at the 2025 Wyndham Championship.The American earned his PGA Tour card through the Korn Ferry Tour, where he finished 19th in the 2020-21 season. The following season, Young played his rookie year on the PGA Tour. The peak of Young’s 2021-22 season was a solo second-place finish at the Open Championship. He also enjoyed four more runner-up finishes and two third-place finishes. At the end of the season, Young won the PGA Tour Rookie of the Year (Arnold Palmer Award) with 94 percent of the vote.In 2014, Young won the AJGA Polo Golf Junior Classic and was selected to represent the United States in both the Junior Ryder Cup and Junior Golf World Cup. Young attended Wake Forest University, and as a freshman in 2015, he won the individual title at the U.S. Collegiate Championship and the Warrior Princeville Makai Invitational.In 2017, Young became the first amateur to win the Metropolitan PGA’s New York State Open; his 64 (7-under par) in the final round at Bethpage Black tied the course record, until Brooks Koepka shot a 63 in the first round of the 2019 PGA Championship.Who is Cameron Young’s caddie?Kyle Sterbinksy is Young’s current caddie. Sterbinsky began life as Young’s caddie at the 2025 Truist Championship.The pair got off to a flying start with a T7 finish in their first event, and a pair of T4 finishes followed that at the RBC Canadian Open and the US Open, before the duo put all the pieces together to win the Wyndham Championship.Sterbinksy and Young were college teammates at Wake Forest, and Young describes Sterbinksy as one of his best friends.Before hiring Sterbinksy, Young had Paul Tesori, a veteran looper, on his bag.
